body.text: Day two. The suppressors changed hands, ATF has said nothing about who is actually covered, and the plaintiffs are now formally demanding answers. Nine days in, not one coverage peer has published a word about any of it.

Strong-access run, second in a row — Reload, AmmoLand, NSSF, SCOTUSblog and all four peers read directly. The overnight story is verified from the primary report: DOJ let the seven-day stay lapse and Silencer Shop transferred suppressors to Brandon Herrera and Rep. Wes Virdell at 12:01 a.m. CT with no Form 4.

facts.title: 1. Silencer Shop v. ATF — day two of a live injunction
2. "Who is actually covered?" — plaintiffs demand ATF answer
3. 27 states clear, 15 require registration, SBRs excluded
